payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly have a chalk-like drawing medium or surface treatment?
node.criteria: pass: visible chalk-like marks or texture establish a chalk medium; fail: the image is clearly rendered in a non-chalk medium with no visible chalk treatment; unknown: the medium cannot be determined from the image.
node.binding: Assess only visible evidence that the image uses a chalk-like medium or treatment.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image has a visibly grainy, smudged surface and soft, powdery-looking marks consistent with a chalk-like treatment.

n3: The node’s aggregation rule is too permissive: it treats two passing component checks as proof of complete fulfillment, but the reference is partial. The edited image clearly shows progress toward a chalk drawing—powdery texture and sketch-like rendering—yet the evidence does not establish that the transformation is fully realized; the giraffes remain highly photographic in detail. Refine the completion criterion to assess whether the combined visual evidence supports the requested transformation as a whole, rather than equating separate “chalk-like” and “drawing-like” cues with completion. Keep the component evidence and distinguish partial progress from absence; do not treat the reference label alone as proof of a specific missing feature. The traces are valid and queried with no transport or dependency failures, so investigate the semantic threshold and evidence-to-status mapping, not execution reliability. High confidence does not resolve this criterion ambiguity.
n2: The binding currently tests only whether the image reads as a drawing, so it can pass on sketch-like outlines even when the requested chalk medium is not established. Make this support check explicitly assess visible chalk-specific evidence as well as drawing-like rendering, while keeping it limited to this component rather than deciding overall completion. The edited image has a powdery, chalk-like surface and softened background, but the giraffes retain detailed, photographic-looking texture; preserve that mixed evidence instead of treating either cue as conclusive. Ensure the criteria distinguish clear evidence, clear absence, and genuinely unresolved evidence, and avoid using confidence or the partial reference label as a substitute for visual support. The trace is valid and queried with no transport or dependency failure, so focus on the binding and evidence-to-status threshold.
